description.value: Stages Bistro & Lounge is a full-service restaurant and lounge situated on the lobby floor of the Holiday Inn Vancouver-Centre on West Broadway. It offers an extensive menu spanning breakfast, lunch, and dinner, plus a Friday seafood lunch buffet and a daily happy hour with discounted cocktails and appetizers. The Broadway location makes it a convenient stop for cyclists moving through central Vancouver.
